facts.fact: Call in internal/memory/claude.go: one isolated structured Claude Code request.
Call.MCPConfig, when set: inline --mcp-config JSON naming only MCP servers call may use; AllowedTools then lists only tools it may call.
Call.Tools, when set, lists built-in read-only file tools call may use, confined to its temp dir, which Files seeds; MaxTurns caps tool loop via --max-turns, 0 leaves it off.
Runner runs one Call, returns structured_output object.
Result: finished call; structured_output plus what Claude Code reported spending.
CLIRunner drives claude CLI headless with every ambient context source switched off, so only system prompt and stdin document visible to model.
claudeArgs does not use --bare: --bare forces ANTHROPIC_API_KEY auth, never reads OAuth/keychain, which breaks subscription login.
For tool calls, --restricted confines Read and Grep to working dir, drops code-running tools; without it, probe P274 showed Read opens absolute path outside cwd under --safe-mode.
--safe-mode kept off for both tool calls and MCP calls, because it disables --mcp-config servers too (measured in P211).
--strict-mcp-config still keeps every other MCP server out of MCP call.
CLIRunner.Available reports whether claude CLI can be found.
CLIRunner.RunResult: Run plus cost and turn count Claude Code reports.
